title: 江上渔者
author: Fan Zhongyan

translation: people come and go on the river
they only love how fine the perch tastes
but look at that boat, a single leaf
rising and sinking in the wind and waves

appreciation: The poem sets diners who praise a delicate fish against the tiny boat that braves the waves to catch it. In four short lines Fan Zhongyan turns a pleasant riverside scene into a question about who pays for pleasure. It is a compact example of the scholar-official's concern for ordinary labour.
